What is a completely randomized design?
column2: Unrelated subjects are randomly assigned to the two treatments, so the two samples are independent.

column1: Why is the pooled variance $s_p^2$ different from the variance of the combined $X$ and $Y$ data?
column2: Pooling uses only within-group variation; the combined variance also includes the between-group difference in means, which can be large.

column1: Why can't we just check whether the sample mean of tumour-size changes is above 0?
column2: Measurements have error, so the sample mean is never exactly 0 even if the treatment does nothing; the t-test decides how large is large enough.
